verdict.rationale: Aqua Security publishes an official trivy-mcp plugin that starts a Model Context Protocol server, exposing Trivy's scanning to VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools, with natural-language security queries. A probe independently confirms the official MCP server repository exists. The evidence is limited to brief README-level claims, so the core capability is clear but the details are thin. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools and setup/transport details, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
